column6: Millie Moon Newborn and Size 1 Diapers.
column22: Last year when my son was born, we had asked for Millie moon diapers as gifts. We strictly used Millie moon from the time he was born. In his first few weeks of life, he developed a rash that was bleeding and creating intense sores around his anus. It didnt go away no matter how many creams we tried. We took him to the pediatrician and they prescribed an anti-fungal cream and that did not work. The only thing that cleared the bleeding rash was laying him on a pee pad and letting his bum air out for hours of a day so the sores would heal. It happened multiple times until I finally realized it might be the diapers. Once we switched it never happened again. Now I am hearing it is happening to more families and I regret not reporting it sooner. We ended up returning over $600 worth of Millie moon diapers.
